source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check AST1060 is provision
2. Upload AST1060 firmware

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; replaces the source's normal AST1060 firmware upload and boot criterion with an unsupported corrupt/downgrade rejection test.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; adds safety for the invented negative scenario but does not restore the normal update intent.
historical_reviews.round_02: No separate exact-code round-02 entry was found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: Consolidated history notes the source requires AST1060 boot success, exposing the prior negative-test drift.

original_test_intent: Update the provisioned AST1060 root-of-trust controller with the exact approved firmware through its supported update path and verify the controller returns with the intended version, boot state and dependent platform-management functions healthy.
original_method: Confirm exact board and AST1060 provisioning/current identity, validate the signed compatible target image and recovery path, upload it through the vendor-supported mechanism, follow update/reset/reconnect milestones and verify target firmware, AST1060 boot, OOB/management reachability and relevant logs.
manual_activity: An authorized user provides and approves the exact AST1060 image, update/recovery plan and maintenance boundary and later issues the verdict. With a supported electronic update interface and independent recovery/console path, upload, monitoring, readback and evidence capture are automatable.
required_inputs: Exact board and AST1060 device/provisioning/current and target versions
Signed image/hash, compatibility matrix, release notes and update preconditions
Vendor update API/tool/version, exact request and task/reset semantics
Stable power, inactive workload, maintenance approval and independent KVM/serial/OOB recovery
Known-good recovery image/procedure, timeouts and dependent management-health checks
safety_requirements: Do not use a corrupt, older or negative image: this case is a normal approved firmware update.
Positively bind the signed image to the exact AST1060 target before upload.
Stop on identity/hash/signature/transfer/verify mismatch, ambiguous task state, loss of independent recovery, boot failure or critical power/thermal anomaly.
Preserve raw failures; do not auto-retry, switch images, clear SEL or power-cycle blindly.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target/image/tool/recovery manifest and capture AST1060, BMC/OOB, BIOS/POST and SEL baselines.
After one-user approval, execute the exact supported update once and follow documented reset, reconnect and boot milestones.
Read back target AST1060 identity/version, dependent health and logs and report Tool Result without declaring PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact target image, supported update path, stable-power and recovery plan.
Remain available for vendor-directed recovery if the RoT controller or OOB path fails.
Review boot/version/dependent-health evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its corrupt/older rejection flow is not source-equivalent. `ipmitool mc info` describes the BMC controller and cannot by itself establish AST1060 target version, RoT boot or update success.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the owner/vendor-supported AST1060 firmware update API/tool with a signed target, task/reset monitoring and AST1060-specific post-update version/boot checks.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Provisioning check, firmware upload, AST1060 boot success and 60/60-minute fields are preserved; the negative-image scenario is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed AST1060 update manifest and durable task ledger covering provisioning/current-target identity, image/tool hashes, update and reset phases, controller boot/reconnect, target readback and dependent management health.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the exact board/AST1060 update and recovery path in the approved manifest.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, AST1060, BMC/BIOS, update API/tool and image versions/hashes.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform-vendor AST1060 update and recovery documentation must be supplied; none was present in the repository.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the normal upload and boot result reproducible without converting it into a rejection test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Restores required successful update and AST1060 boot coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: AST1060 may anchor firmware trust and OOB recovery; independent recovery must remain available during update.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve its exact target and endpoint. A corrupt/downgrade rejection test is a separate case and cannot satisfy this normal update record.
expected_evidence: Board/AST1060 provisioning/current-target identity, image hash/signature, tool/API and authorization
Stable-power/independent-recovery readiness and pre-update OOB/POST/SEL baseline
Target AST1060 version/identity, boot and OOB/dependent-service health, logs, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently describe a normal AST1060 firmware upload followed by boot success. The corrupt/downgrade objective appears only in historical reviews and is rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The normal update intent is clear. Exact image/tool/recovery artifacts are readiness inputs; after supply and approval the electronic core and evidence can be automated.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its non-equivalent negative-image substitution and PARTIAL classification while retaining strict firmware safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Its negative-fixture blocker does not apply to the source; identity, stable power and recovery controls remain useful for the normal update.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Restores successful RoT update coverage and adds target-specific boot and dependent-health evidence.

review_improvement: Prevents a rejection test from replacing the required successful AST1060 update and separates package/approval readiness from automatable capability.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source requires provision check, approved firmware upload and AST1060 boot—not corrupt-image rejection. With exact artifacts and an electronic update/recovery interface, every core operation and evidence step is automatable; high criticality does not make it PARTIAL or BLOCKED.
